runtimes.title: uv (builds Python environments)

licence.name: Apache 2.0 or MIT
licence.summary: Free to use, change and share, commercially too, under either licence, keeping the notice. YUKI uses it only to build the Python environments ComfyUI and Strata run in, inside their own folders.

runtimes.notes: Astral's Python package manager. It makes private Python environments, so nothing is installed into a Python you already have.

runtimes.title: llama.cpp server (CUDA 12)

licence.name: MIT
licence.summary: Free to use, change and share, commercially too, keeping the copyright notice. The CUDA runtime files that come with it are NVIDIA's, under NVIDIA's own redistributable licence.

runtimes.notes: Runs the 27B brain and the small brain on your graphics card. The build YUKI is tested with; it needs an NVIDIA driver from 2024 or newer.

runtimes.title: ComfyUI (pictures, video and music)

licence.name: GNU GPL 3.0
licence.summary: Free to use, change and share, commercially too. If you share a changed copy of ComfyUI itself, it has to stay GPL with its source. What you make with it is yours. Setting it up also downloads PyTorch for CUDA and the Python packages ComfyUI lists, each under its own licence.

runtimes.notes: Makes pictures, video and music on your graphics card. YUKI builds its own Python environment for it (PyTorch for CUDA, a few GB), separate from anything else on the PC. That PyTorch is built for CUDA 13, so it needs an NVIDIA driver from the R580 branch (mid-2025) or newer.

runtimes.title: Strata (the big brain engine)

licence.name: MIT
licence.summary: Free to use, change and share, commercially too, keeping the copyright notice. Strata's own setup also downloads its ready-made engine and Python packages (NVIDIA's CUDA libraries among them), each under its own licence.

runtimes.notes: Runs the big brain (Flash-Next) across your graphics card and RAM. YUKI runs Strata's own setup for you; that is new on a fresh PC, so if it stops, the smaller brain keeps working and YUKI says what happened. Its engine is built for CUDA 13: NVIDIA driver R580 or newer.
